title: Disabling NOC via the settings row leaves an open panel drawn and unclosable — the draw and feed gates ignore noc_enabled
detail: Player opens the panel (D), then sets 'NOC PANEL (D)' OFF: noc_enabled=false but overlay_on stays true, so draw_noc_overlay keeps rendering and D becomes a no-op. The panel is stuck visible, contradicting README's 'turns the feature off entirely'.
recommended_fix: In the SETTINGS_ROW_NOC case also clear overlay_on when disabling, and/or gate the draw and feed scan on noc_enabled && overlay_on.

title: noc_mark only advances while the panel is open — first D press folds the entire run's event backlog in one frame, now in every build
detail: While overlay_on is false, app.noc_mark never advances; toggling the panel on mid-run scans app.state.events[noc_mark:] — the whole history, O(backlog) in one frame. Previously PP_DEBUG-only; now every player build runs it.
recommended_fix: Advance noc_mark (and the reject latch) every frame regardless of overlay_on, or snap the mark to len(events) when the panel opens.

title: The 'default ON' pin asserts a default the test sets itself — flipping the boot default (the documented removal path) fails no test
detail: noc_default_app hardcodes noc_enabled=true, then the test expects it true — it pins the helper, not main's boot. The PR's one-line removal flip in app/main.odin would leave all four 'mutation-proven' pins green.
recommended_fix: Exercise the real boot path (or a shared init proc main calls) so the default is pinned in product code, not in test scaffolding.

title: PR body claims the settings 'row hit-test' convention was followed, but no diff hunk updates hit-testing or panel geometry for the fifth row
evidence:
+**Settings-panel conventions (rule 4).** New row `SETTINGS_ROW_NOC` — **"NOC PANEL (D)" ON/OFF** — in the existing settings panel (S / the bottom-left chip), following the exact panel conventions: row constant, label/value, value-chip color, row hit-test, adjust+persist flow.
---
-SETTINGS_ROW_COUNT :: 4
+SETTINGS_ROW_COUNT :: 5
detail: The diff adds the row constant, label, chip color, and adjust case, but shows no hit-test or settings_panel_rect change. If either hardcodes the 4-row layout, the new row is unreachable by mouse or overflows the card.
recommended_fix: Show/confirm the hit-test and card-height code derive from SETTINGS_ROW_COUNT; otherwise add the missing hunk.

title: The self-exiting e2e drive (synthetic input, screenshots, mkdir bin) now ships in every binary behind only the PP_NOC_E2E env var
detail: Removing the PP_DEBUG wrapper compiles scripted-D injection, TakeScreenshot calls, bin/ creation, and the forced break into release builds. A stray PP_NOC_E2E in a player/CI environment makes the game press keys and exit itself. The get_env_alloc string also leaks.
recommended_fix: Keep the e2e arm behind an explicit build define or a separate tool; at minimum free the env string and document the release-visible behavior.
